scene_purpose: Deliver Hollow Watch's sole major cartographic payoff in one protected mural: regional catastrophe imagery, ordinary people moving underground at multiple places, recognizable Hollow Watch geography, the southern Junction, and a prominent unknown monument there.

scene_context_seed.location_name: protected mural chamber beyond Hollow Watch Castellan
scene_context_seed.runtime_note: One sustained mural conversation. The mural is visual-first. Torren recognizes Hollow Watch and then the Junction as real geography; he knows the crossroads but has never seen the depicted monument. Do not resolve the catastrophe, tunnel purpose, monument function, or complete route network. After the scene, Hollow Watch ends and the game transitions directly to Greenhollow: no playable backtrack, overlook resolution, second Junction discussion, or exit-dungeon dialogue.

required_story_beats: Enter the protected mural chamber beyond the defeated Castellan.
Show falling-fire catastrophe imagery and ordinary people moving underground across multiple locations.
Torren recognizes Hollow Watch, establishing real geography.
Torren recognizes the Junction but not the prominent monument shown there.
Decide to inspect the Junction while already traveling south.
